body:
## Problem

Approved PR delivery required agents to reconstruct squash merging, branch cleanup, issue closeout and harness reconciliation through individual commands. Partial failures could leave those steps difficult to resume safely.

## What changes

Add a supported `harness_state.py wrap-up` command and `Harness.wrap_up` API. Explicit approval binds the repository, PR, accepted head and completed run revision. The command journals delivery, verifies the squash parent and tree, safely deletes the recorded source refs, confirms eligible issues completed and records delivery evidence. It preserves the accepted candidate separately from the merge commit and confirms the exact orphan artifact checkpoint.

Update the skill to present verification and request approval once, honor existing scoped approval, and use the same command for recovery. A compact result distinguishes delivery, incomplete work and decisions.

## Why this matters

The routine approved workflow becomes one command, with durable recovery after interrupted or uncertain external operations. Unrelated worktrees, edits and unfinished parent issues remain protected.

## Why this approach

Delivery extends the existing lock, artifact CAS and integrity checks while retaining independent unit/final acceptance. Head, base, check or task drift requires a decision. Each destructive operation uses intent, authoritative readback and conditional source identities.

## Verification and limits

The implementer, fresh independent unit checker, and separate fresh final checker each passed all 19 bounded plan-2 gates on `48ac3bdd418d3473689f978ecfc8ab298704d753`: 130 discovered/executed tests, 103 boundary scenarios, and all 113 original direct methods accounted for, with no skipped checks. The unit checker also independently reproduced the four repaired no-send publication cases and two ambiguous crash cases. The longest final-check group took 323 seconds against its 600-second deadline. Live issue inputs and the exact eligible closing target were re-read before final acceptance.

Tests use fake GitHub transport and real disposable Git repositories/bare remotes for mutation-boundary recovery, publication failure, approval fencing, squash identity and preservation checks. Read-only probes confirm installed `gh` behavior for zero checks. Production GitHub merge/deletion/closure behavior was not exercised. No C++/Vulkan behavior changes.

## Task references

Closes https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/issues/39
